rate_limits: No numeric hourly quota is published. Fair-use policy requires submitting only one API request at a time; simultaneous requests are prohibited.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Replace the unsupported ~1200 requests/hour claim; current official policy permits only one request at a time: https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/doc/index.php. cors: Set to no; the same official policy states these APIs may not be embedded in websites under NASA's CORS policy: https://ssd-api.jpl.nasa.gov/doc/index.php.
